messages:
Maya: quick notes from today's perf run on FP8 enablement — H100 + L40S. Observed a tail latency spike when KV cache hit ratio > 70% in steady state. dumping findings here

Tomas: saw ~30-50ms p99 increase on the generation path. profiler shows frequent kernel_selector flips around step 48 which aligns with the tail spikes.

Sarah: flip = kernel thrash. my guess: batching heuristics change microbatch composition mid-flight (seq_len distribution shifts), runtime decides to reroute to a different kernel, causes extra serialization/deserialize.

Andre: is this H100-only? L40S behaved much better in our smoke runs.

Maya: larger on H100 yes. suspect TE fp8 kernels + a cuDNN fallback path when occupancy dips. quick profiler excerpt: 
```
KERNEL SWITCH @00:48
 selector=dynamic -> picked=fp8_fast -> serialization_delay=2.8ms -> BACKOFF -> picked=int8_stable
 kv_miss=0.12 kv_hit=0.88 batch_size=4 -> microbatch_split=2
```

Tomas: interesting that kv_hit is high. that suggests hot cache keys, so kernel handoffs are happening despite same KV data. we should avoid switching kernels mid-request when kv_hit > 0.6.

Sarah: we have `pinned_kernel_hint` but it's advisory only. two options: make sticky-routing stronger for hot keys, or change fallback policy to only trigger on hard error (not perf delta).

Andre: caution — earlier fp8_fast on long sequences caused jitter on H100 (numeric scaling/calim mismatch?). any quality regressions observed?

Maya: yes small token-prob drift after ~600 tokens when switching mid-request. not huge, but consistent on a subset of QA prompts. suggests calibration state isn't preserved across kernel switch.

DeployBot: CI perf run (canary/fp8-sticky) finished. p50/p90 stable, p99 down ~18% vs master. Build fb3a2.

Sarah: :thumbsup: proposal for canary run 2: (1) disable dynamic kernel switching for in-flight requests, (2) increase `kv_warmup_eviction_threshold` 0.2 -> 0.5, (3) enable `TE_FP8_ROUND_TO_NEAREST=1` to reduce calibration jitter.

Tomas: rolling runtime patch now: `--kernel-policy=sticky_if_kv_hit>0.6 --disable-inflight-switch=true`

Andre: also enable `transformer_engine.fp8.rounding = nearest` in TE config; should reduce small stochastic drifts when quantized accumulators see long contexts.

Maya: kicking off controlled run on H100 pool with same workload and long-context QA eval. will collect flamegraphs + token-prob diffs. if this fixes tail we add heuristic: prefer kernel stickiness when KV hit high and disallow mid-request kernel change.

Sarah: also add regression alarm: if kernel_switch_count > 3 per request AND p99 increases > 10ms, auto-create a pager ticket. add long-context QA to perf CI.

Maya: thanks all — uploading artifacts when done. last message ts: 2248001299
